content: MS Majlis 10196 f. 120a-20b (as printed) carries the R. fī Sharḥ Ḥaqīqat al-Waḥda al-Muṭlaqa al-Dhātiyya (variant title R. al-Khatmiyya), copied on 3 Dhū l-Ḥijja 827/27 October 1424; it is the only copy listed. No catalogue reference and no asterisk are printed, and the entry does not state a composition date.
refers_to_primary: R. fī Sharḥ Ḥaqīqat al-Waḥda, MS Majlis 10196
